performance.notes: No performance-specific changes (caching, pooling) were made. The RLock usage is lightweight, but registry operations could benefit from caching (e.g., get_all_categories). Resource cleanup is not addressed.

documentation.notes: No documentation updates (docstrings, README, or architecture docs) were included in the changeset. The structured logging events imply good operational docs, but developer-facing documentation is lacking.

deployment.notes: No deployment-related changes (Docker, CI/CD, dependency management) were made. The system's deployment readiness is inferred from runtime success but not explicitly improved in this changeset.
